config.diagnostic_policy: Report every dataset/seed and fixed checkpoint; paired factorial effects, V-selected checkpoints and fixed-final effects separately. DualClock 360-vs-1440 selection and event ablations are adaptive V diagnostics, not fresh test evidence. No all-dataset improvement gate.
config.scope: Train/V diagnostics only. Reused development data; no E access, no scientific PASS/FAIL, no automatic further research.

anchor.precision: BF16 autocast; FP32 parameters and AdamW

dualclock.precision: FP32, same native loss scaling as original Candidate02
